variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/height
variables.description: control.size.sm — 16px box edge for a SQUARE control's own dimension: a checkbox square or a radio circle (density: comfortable). A square control reads this on both axes. A switch's track is NOT square and reads `track`/`width` instead (#1425).

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/width
variables.description: control.size.sm width — 48px track width for a two-position control, i.e. a switch (2x the 24px `track` height, the field-convergent 2:1 track ratio). A square control uses `height` on both axes and does not read this.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/dot
variables.description: control.size.sm dot — 8px inner mark for a RADIO's dot (half the 16px box edge, leaving a 4px gap to the boundary). A control whose mark is a GLYPH draws it full-bleed at `height`; a switch's traveling thumb reads `thumb` instead.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/line-box
variables.description: control.size.sm line-box — 21px, the height of one line of the `body.sm` label (fontSize × line-height, baked). A selection control sits in a box this tall and centres within it, so it tracks the FIRST line of a wrapping label instead of floating mid-paragraph (#1201 / #1009).

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/inset
variables.description: control.size.sm inset — 3px gap between the thumb and the track's boundary ((24px track − 18px thumb) ÷ 2). Read as a track's uniform padding by a control whose mark travels, i.e. a switch's thumb, so the thumb clears the track's ends at both extremes instead of sitting flush. A control whose mark is centred and static does not read it.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/radius
variables.description: control.size.sm radius — 2px corner on the 16px box edge (min of radius.sm 2px and the 16÷8 control ratio, snapped to the 2px radius sub-grid). CLAMPED to the box rather than taken from the radius ramp: a fixed-size control does not scale its corner the way a card does (#1015).

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/track
variables.description: control.size.sm track — 24px track HEIGHT for a switch (Prism 2's 32px toggle at the default `md`; density: comfortable). The switch's own cross-axis edge, larger than the 16px square-control `height` because a track holds a traveling thumb. A checkbox/radio does not read it.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/thumb
variables.description: control.size.sm thumb — 18px traveling thumb for a switch (0.75 × the 24px `track`, Prism 2's toggle proportion). Larger than a radio's `dot` because the switch's mark is the moving element the eye tracks. A checkbox/radio does not read it.
